info.title: skillmeter — measure what your agent skills cost in context.
info.description: Measure what your agent skills cost in context. Offline, cross-agent, CI-friendly.

commands.name: budget
commands.description: What the skill listing costs and which skills it evicts. (default)

options.name: --path
options.description:
Scan this directory instead of the standard agent
locations. A bare argument works too.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON (versioned schema).

options.name: --top
options.description: Rows to show in `cost`. Default 25.

options.name: --window
options.description: Context window in tokens. Default 200000.

options.name: --fraction
options.description:
Share of the window reserved for the skill listing.
Default 0.01, matching skillListingBudgetFraction.

options.name: --max-desc-chars
options.description:
Per-skill listing cap. Default 1536, matching
skillListingMaxDescChars.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit 1 if listing metadata exceeds this. For CI.

options.name: --fail-over-budget
options.description: Exit 1 if the listing is over the computed budget.

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Exit 1 if any path could not be read, so an
incomplete scan cannot quietly pass a gate.

options.name: --tokenizer
options.description: o200k (default) or approx (chars/4, for comparison).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version.
EXIT CODES
0  ok        1  gate failed        2  usage error        3  runtime error
1 is returned only when a gate was requested: --fail-on,
--fail-over-budget or --strict. Measuring is never itself a failure.
